concepts.def: Reactions in cells that release energy from glucose for life processes.
Respiration releases energy — it is exothermic.
Uses oxygen: glucose + O₂ → CO₂ + H₂O + energy. More efficient.
Molecule used to store and transfer the energy released in respiration.
Movement (muscle contraction), keeping warm, building large molecules, active transport.
Site of most aerobic respiration in eukaryotic cells.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Breathing & Respiration — a core area of GCSE Biology.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Breathing & Respiration brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Breathing & Respiration.
